title: Evaluating Frontier-Model Agent Skills with Open-Weight Models in a Science Gateway
abstract: arXiv:2611.31480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific analyses that span many jobs and computing sites depend on workflow management systems to run reliably, but writing a production workflow requires expertise in such a system, which many domain scientists do not have. Coding agents can supply this expertise when they are guided by skills and packaged procedures for recurring tasks. We wrote skills and specialist agents for the Pegasus workflow management system with a frontier model, and the PegasusAI Studio science gateway offers them to scientists through a chat interface. New users without frontier-model credits need an open-weight model, served at no cost on research cyberinfrastructure, but skills written for a frontier model may not work with an open-weight solution. This paper presents a method for adapting such skills. An evaluation harness drives the real gateway as a user would, scores the workflows the agent builds, and feeds recurring failures back to the frontier m

translated_title: 在科学网关中使用开放权重模型评估前沿模型的智能体技能
translated_abstract: 跨越多个作业和计算站点的科学分析依赖工作流管理系统才能可靠运行，但编写生产级工作流需要此类系统的专业知识，而许多领域科学家并不具备这种专业知识。编码智能体在由技能和针对重复任务的打包流程引导时，可以提供这种专业知识。我们使用前沿模型为 Pegasus 工作流管理系统编写了技能和专门智能体，并通过 PegasusAI Studio 科学网关以聊天界面向科学家提供这些能力。没有前沿模型使用额度的新用户需要一个开放权重模型，该模型可在科研网络基础设施上免费提供，但为前沿模型编写的技能可能无法直接用于开放权重模型。本文提出了一种适配此类技能的方法：一个评估测试框架像真实用户一样驱动实际网关，对智能体构建的工作流进行评分，并将反复出现的失败反馈给前沿模型（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种方法，通过自动评估测试框架驱动真实科学网关、对生成的 Pegasus 工作流评分并把反复出现的失败反馈给前沿模型，从而将前沿模型编写的智能体技能适配到科研基础设施上免费提供的开放权重模型，使没有前沿模型额度的科学家也能用聊天界面构建可靠的科学工作流。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a method for adapting agent skills written for a frontier model to free open-weight models served on research cyberinfrastructure, using an evaluation harness that drives the real science gateway, scores the generated Pegasus workflows, and feeds recurring failures back to the frontier model.
